CustomField.description: Indicates whether a Taxonomy automation process is currently in progress. This flag is set to TRUE at the beginning of the BSF_Batch_BSFPortfolio execution and remains true until all chained Taxonomy batches have completed. Used by downstream processes—such as the Platform Event trigger (Add_Update_OpptyTeamMembers)—to prevent unintended BSF_Batch_OpportunityTeamSync batch executions during Taxonomy processing.
